text: Call Issued: June 5, 2018 Call Closed: July 9, 2018 Number of Addenda Issued: One (1) Number of Bids: Four (4) Table 2: Summary of Bids Received for Request for Quotation 6604-18-0133 including Bid price: Bidder Name Evaluated Bid Price (including HST): Chem-Aqua Canada $213,938 Rochester Midland $223,566 Jutzi Water Technologies $244,257 Magnus Chemicals Ltd. $251,837

The Bid Award Panel adopted the following: 1. Bid Award Panel grant authority to award the contract in accordance with the Contract Details set out in the report (September 19, 2018) from the Chief Purchasing Officer: Call Number: Request for Quotation 6604-18-0133 Description: The non-exclusive supply of all labour, materials, equipment and supervision necessary for the provision of chemical water treatment program. The chemical water treatment program will include chemicals, biocides, test chemicals, reagents, reporting, legionella, brine, glycol testing and laboratory analysis, including building operator training at various locations, for the City of Toronto’s Facilities Management Division, for a period of 1 year from the date of award, with the option to renew the Contract for four (4) additional separate one (1) year periods.
